2025.6.29 初次游玩，打了教程关卡，刚进入大世界。 讲道理，词条里面有rogue，但是游戏设定远超传统rogue 交互、场景设计实在是让人震撼。 就简单开坑一下，回头再玩玩） ———————————————————— 2025.7.6 TMD这是何等优秀的游戏！ 国区steam定价69元，打折55元。 你给我说这个价钱能有这种质量的游戏？ TMD作者太优秀了！ 复杂的地形、庞大的箱庭、爽快的战斗、惊喜的探索 画质虽然是像素风，但是通过渲染加工，不输于大作 大部分游玩体验过于好了。 谈谈游戏缺点） 个人认为地图虽然庞大、比较充实，但是由于人物移动能力强，有些地方总觉得有好东西） 导致玩的时候反而觉得地图里一些地方布置的莫名其妙。 地图内地标物的指引感觉不是太多，很多地方、玩法缺少指引，玩着玩着有时也很迷茫） 比如：我到现在不知道中毒、虚弱、燃烧这些的效果具体是什么，通过观察部分了解了，但还是有好些东西不明白 游戏其实是有主线内容的，目前看起来是有一点单线剧情+支线，但是剧情这些没有什么指引、文本介绍，以至于我刚刚看到商店页面才想起来是怎么回事） 目前游戏还在更新，可以看出来作者在一些地方辛勤耕耘，也有一些荒废的地方（比如技能，我刚刚到雪地，没有获得任何新技能，没看攻略不清楚是不是错过了） 希望作者再接再厉~ ———————————————————————————————————— 2025.7.6 可以看出啊，作者野心很大 第三张图极其庞大，建模工作是下足了功夫 美中不足的就是地图内的节点有点稀疏了，或者节点内没有什么”宝物“ 导致我跑图纯粹看风景，怪也不好打，就是跑，难度曲线设置有点） 希望除了天空节点传送，再出点其他的快速移动方式 我是觉得游戏底子非常非常好，按照现在的情况，可以考虑出点空战、坐骑之类的，能够极大丰富游戏性。 （所以，是不是目前还没有新能力啊，就初始三个？） —————————————————————————————————————— 2025.7.9 TMD老子跑了半天把第三图的剧情武器做出来了 转手就被逼迫给了那个作者懒得做说话口型的臭娘们！ 威胁咱们不给东西不给你开门打boss 希望作者加一个干掉她的选项）

一坨，没有传送，没有回程，刷鸡毛

进入一个地下图逛了1、2个小时开箱子各种部件1到2页加近6位数资源，没有找到任何一个可以撤离的地方，开了个传送点因为在地下还不能传送，又因为这个区域就开了这一个点，所以这玩意只能当个辨别方位的路标。遇到复数隐形怪+复数远程怪的区域死掉了，为什么死呢？隐形怪会在突进的攻击后一直尝试远离你，只能打中1到2下，而处理掉它需要2位数的命中次数，同时他又会在袭击后铺设带毒的路径，带属性的远程怪也会铺负面路径，导致隐形怪节奏一错开+带属性的远程怪=狭小的地形内几乎没有闪躲空间=死亡。死亡=前面1到2小时的所有收获（装备+资源）掉落，复活起来一看，身上就1个心脏，其余全掉死亡地点。回去捡尸除了需要打碎肉块，然后再长按拾取才能拿回原来的东西，所以基本没可能不杀怪捡回尸体。期间再次死亡等于数小时开了数十个1次性宝箱的所有装备消失，那有其他办法速杀怪吗？游戏没有道具设定，唯一可能需要准备相关的这个空中坠落伤害设定，从极高处落下的伤害连个小怪都炸不死。尝试捡了两次尸体但拿着更新的装备都没打过怎么可能靠旧的随便组的装备过呢？现在1身破烂，原先每个都1、2页的部件也没可能再回来了，如果刷怪去获取这些按之前的经验需要5小时以上，不过丢不丢可能影响也不大，反正也不知道究竟到哪里才能撤离把这些带走。 想着放松一下用鼠标的食指冲动买的游戏，结果发现支持手柄但手柄无论是跑酷还是目标选择基本都只是映射没有针对优化，也可能是我手柄用得不好。手柄打开背包不能用左摇杆只能用方向键选中。小问题很多。 更新路线图里说已经更新了任务但到现在不知道游戏目标是啥，中了怪物的毒有啥效果也不知道，没有任何一个地方有各类词条效果说明。到现在不知道大概哪些场景能被符文攻击破坏，除了教程关之后一个都没见到。原先快结束探索的死亡区域怪重新刷了黑漆漆的也不知道哪是哪。现在完全没有继续游玩探索的动力，隐藏箱子里资源不能再生却可以随意失去，我的耐心也一样。
优点：砍怪爽过吸猫，刷装肝度良心，撤离设计像亲妈般温柔； 槽点：地图比初恋还难懂，内容量堪比早餐肠粉里的肉——少得可怜！ 建议入坑人群：想体验“疯批战士在线回血”的莽夫/想给Steam库存+1的刷子； 慎入人群：路痴/痛恨半成品的强迫症——毕竟现在这版本，撑死算个五星战力的试吃装

这游戏就算只有第一章内容卖我60多也值 战锤鼠疫+影子武士2的打击风格 老头环的背景美术风格 还有刷子游戏的刷装备BD养成 画面不精细但是后期处理让整体看起来还有那么一回事感觉真不影响游玩，点名批评近几年有些大厂在画质上无脑堆料游戏内容确做成一坨这种怪异行为，纯属丢了西瓜捡芝麻，占用丰富的游戏开发资源却接二连三拉一坨坨....所以这两年还真得看这种独立小厂做出来的游戏，全是心意没有敷衍，所以一玩就对味！

The overall concept of the game is great but fighting in an arena covered in aoe while also having to dodge non-stop projectiles is not my idea of fun.

一个这个，一个MORTAL SIN，我愿称之为第一人称砍杀独立游戏的双壁，各有各的爽 如果是个人制作者的话确实很厉害，游戏非常的有镜头感 +++最高难度数值很夸张，而且上来直接能解锁，但是还好目前版本各种技能和被动解锁的很快，很快就能凑出伤害很高的异常流，但是容错率目前还是没什么提升很大的技能，怪堆里的存活率不容乐观 +++爽，近战，闪避，弹反的手感很不错 +++虽然还不是正式版，但流派看起来很多，但是高难度的数值目测纯物理不太容易 ---指引太少了，非常需要小地图 ---怪物种类太少了，而且目前这几种连颜色都是一个派系的
指引这一块真是太烂了，日志和武器也没有完全覆盖中文，这种一半中文一半英文太难受 亡灵之城拿镰刀那里也懒得喷，10个发波怪和大怪加上风火轮来撞你，这还只是其中一回合，太难了 心脏系统也有问题，5心换1心再重新换到5心，直接少4颗心不给你补 雪原从天而降的怪物的源头巢穴，就那个叫什么血腥巢穴那里，黑成啥了，啥都看不见 武器也是很多换皮

游戏有些潜力，但是很多设计不当人：奇怪的视距攻击判定。地图设计不太好。莫名奇妙位置的传送点。角色太脆死亡捡尸跑死人，路上不小心又死了那钱全没。目前装备不怎么多构建BD不太好弄。武器模组有些重复。重武器我个人感觉不太好用。完全没任何必要存在的普通攻击提前预输入判定。默认闪避距离稍短。收刀后的出刀攻击动作过于墨迹不够干净利落。掉落出的东西既然全都是有用的为啥还要设定拾取范围，装备还让玩家手动捡，根据这游戏的动作砍杀理念设计成杀死怪和开箱子全程全范围自动拾取不行吗，既方便又不打断玩家节奏，这样不好吗。目前到第3章，遇到了最畜牲的敌人：隐身双刀，隐身后基本很难发现，攻击的方式全是突击，现身位置也不确定，而且攻击必带范围冰锥一落就是好几个（默认闪避距离短的问题就暴露出来了），外加还成群出现，能设计出这种敌人这他妈还是个人？看见这种最好的办法是避战，非要打我能想到最好的办法用范围技能等CD强行耗死，如果非要让玩家这么玩是不是跟游戏设计的初衷背道而驰了？至少我个人认为作者初衷应该是让玩家用各种技巧和技能来战斗爽的，但是目前的内容实在不够也太糙
牛哦 这么远的传送点让你跑尸 技能特效糊满了屏幕 跑了半小时结果被一堆小怪丢屎丢死捡尸体都没法捡

你是一名为战争而生的毁灭机器，可惜你没有任何技能，没有任何让人眼前一亮的能力（特长），你从敌人那里收集来的武器甚至都比你自身有用，不妨讲个笑话。 主角除了无视跌落，格挡和闪避和收刀“跑酷”，我完全看不出来他有任何特殊点能体现他是个为战而生的毁灭者。 所以请制作组加强主角吧，给他一些逆天技能，让我们玩家感觉到什么是“战斗！爽！！！让敌人颤抖吧！！！” 希望可以技能相互叠加，顺便说一嘴，那个“技能”树太肝了，所需要的点数完全不够，提升不大整体而言便是食之无味，弃之可惜。 总结：是个好游戏，提升空间非常大，加油，制作组，看好你们，所以好评拿去。（推荐） ------------------------------------------ You are a destruction machine born for war, but unfortunately, you have no skills and no abilities that really catch people's attention. The weapons you gather from enemies are even more useful than you are. You might as well tell a joke. Aside from ignoring falls, blocking, dodging, and performing 'parkour' with your sheath, I can't see any special feature that shows he is a destroyer born for battle. So please, dev team, strengthen the main character. Give him some overpowered skills so that we players can truly feel what ''combat ! Awesome ! ! ! Make the enemies tremble!!! Kill ! Kill ! ! Kill ! ! ! '' really means. I hope the skills can be stacked together. By the way, that 'skill' tree is way too grindy; the points required are nowhere near enough, and the improvements are minimal—in general, it's not very satisfying to use, but too good to ignore. In summary: It's a good game with huge potential for improvement. Keep it up, dev team, I’m rooting for you. so here's a well-deserved positive review. (Recommended) -------------------------------------------------- Ты — машина разрушения, созданная для войны, но, к сожалению, у тебя нет никаких навыков и способностей, которые могли бы впечатлить (особых талантов). Оружие, которое ты собираешь у врагов, даже полезнее тебя самого. Можешь, кстати, рассказать анекдот. Главный герой, кроме как игнорировать падения, блокировать и уворачиваться и «паркурить» с оружием, ничем особенным не выделяется, чтобы показать, что он создан для разрушения в бою. Так что, пожалуйста, команда разработчиков, усилите главного героя, дайте ему крутые навыки, чтобы мы, игроки, почувствовали, что такое «Бой! Круто!!! Пусть враги дрожат!!! Убивай! Убивай!! Убивай!!!» Надеюсь, навыки можно комбинировать друг с другом. Кстати, это дерево навыков слишком утомительное, очков явно не хватает, прокачка почти незаметна, в целом игра безвкусная, но жалко бросать. Итог: отличная игра, но есть огромный потенциал для улучшения. Держитесь, команда разработчиков, мы верим в вас, поэтому заслуженный положительный отзыв. (Рекомендую)

Great concept for a game. Gameplay and exploration are great. Act 3 might have the worst possible designed quest in gaming history that I have ever come across. I've been gaming for over 30 years. I have spent 10 hours actually playing the game and 12 hours running above/through Blizzards - with guides open - and am not even close to completing it. They also don't de-spawn once you "complete" them, so I guess I will just never progress past this part. Quest needs to be removed completely, or atleast have a vender item that can guide you. My character is level 18 and I can defeat every boss and challenge on high difficulty, fly through an entire map while never touching the ground, and kill most enemies in 1 hit. My character is unkillable. The Blizzard quest is uncompleteable. I would recommend not have any expectations past Act 2 and I probably wont play again until the Quest is removed/reworked/a guide item purchaseable or earned.

Very confusing. Definitely needs a tutorial or some sort of journal dynamic in the game to help players figure out what the heck is going on. Lots of swords, lots of amulets, lots of rings...but very limited explanation of how to bring it all together. After navigating through some ice caves, you come to a base area with some sorts of temples with options to upgrade, some sort of fruit tree, a pillar with movable skulls to change mechanics. Jumping into a world with one sword verses another didn't not seem to have much of a point. Trying to find a strong build seems important, but how to pull these mystifying and largely unexplained mechanics together to do this quickly became an exercise in frustration, tiring, and...not fun.

Nah. I get why people like it, and I probably would have too, if I were younger and still had decent reflexes. Sadly, I'm old and slow, and it's just far too punishing to be enjoyable for me. Edit 20/06/2026 Tried again after latest update. Still think it's utterly incredible that a single person made it, still think i'd have loved this even a few years ago. But i'm still not enjoying it - and that's fine. I'm not saying it's [i]bad[/i], because it's absolutely not. Some of the comments on this review seem to either take issue with the fact I personally don't like something they do, or assuming i'm unaware of some of the mechanics. The mechanics are fantastic, the aesthic is fantastic, the sound design is actually better than a lot of games which have a far bigger team and budget. [b]This is not a bad game, this is just not a game for me.[/b] To address the comments: [olist] [*] i understand there are lots of difficulty options. in some ways thats the problem; there doesn't seem to be a difficulty sweet spot. it's either not fun to play FOR ME because i get booped --> fall down go boom OR it's not fun to play FOR ME because i can walk in a straight line unleashing death. following on from this: [*] if you think this is a souls like, you have outed yourself as never having actually played a soulslike. [*] To be clear, I have played demon souls, ds2, ds3 to absolute death on my PS3/4. I suffered through the frustration of my aging reflexes for elden ring because, my god, what a game. Probably in my top 3 of all time. Returnal is another one; I originally HATED the werid difficulty, pacing, and meta-progression, but the story was cosmic horror and had what I can only describe as a China-Mieville-esque feel (if you haven't read any of his books, you probably should). Anyway, I was stuck on the first boss for months, but everything [i]around[/i] the gameplay kept me coming back. I eventually finished the game fully. (Side note: i'm still pissed about the narrative blue-balling Returnal caused, but whatever.) [/olist] now, (2) and (3) speak to my entire point for this negative review: [i]I suffered through ER and Returnal because they had hooks around the gameplay[/i]. You don't typically get that in rogue-lites / rogue-likes a la Voin, at least not to the same extent. (again, the game would be technically and aesthetically amazing for a much larger team/budget). I play rogue-likes and rogue-lites because I am in my 40's and have a demanding career/home life. I want something that I can pick up and play for 30-60 minutes and enjoy winning or losing while making a tiny bit of meta progress. I just don't have the time to git gud for something i personally find frustrating. The fact that I'm putting this much effort into a negative review is because the whole binary "yes/no" review format is designed for easy metrics in bulk. It has no nuance - which is understandable, because apparently your average steam reviewer is incapable of nuance anyway. So, here it is a little louder for those hard of hearing: [h2] [olist] [*] Voin is not a bad game, it's just not for 2026 p4ndr. pre-2016 p4ndr would have [i]loved[/i] it. [*] It's okay for you to like something I don't like. [*] Sometimes, people don't have the energy to git gud without a narrative carrot being dangled in front of them. [/olist] [/h2]

I really loved this game. Then I really liked this game. Then I grew to hate this game. All in a span of 9 hours. Let's get into it. The first act/level felt really good! The difficulty goes up at a good rate for you to learn the ropes, and it is pretty clear on where you are supposed to be heading, and what is obviously side areas with extra loot. I cranked the density of enemies to max, and enemy variants to max, and still felt good about the difficulty and pacing in this first level. The arena presented a real challenge to unlock a weapon! The second act/level felt quite a bit more empty, but still okay. Exploring felt less rewarding, as some areas that seemed promising ended up bare, with no secret loot or event to be found. The way forward once you enter the mushroom cave was not clear, and I spent a good amount of time trying to progress forward by fumbling upon the right path eventually. Even though this area as a whole was bigger, it was emptier because of it. Difficulty wise, I felt as if the game had already shown me all it had to offer. The few new enemies in the zone didn't present a challenge, and I already felt I had nothing new to look forward to in terms of weapons or other equipment/augmentations. The third act/level started out promising. An NPC to get some lore from? A quest? Giants?! Sounds good to me! Oh but how I was fooled. The third act is egregiously huge in comparison to the first two acts combined, with very few indicators on where to travel. I feel like 80% of my time there was running and dashing from place to place, with very little reward to exploration for secrets. There is an isolated castle that you must cross a long broken bridge to get to, with a few enemies inside. I climbed this castle to the top to find nothing, and searched every nook and cranny to no avail. Just a big empty castle with a few dudes. A bit disappointing. Once I received my second part of the quest to enter blizzards for 5 quest items, it all fell apart for me. These blizzards are so far apart from each other, with nothing happening on the journey in-between. The quest items you need to find are white, in the middle of a blizzard. I found the first one after trekking through the first blizzard for 5 minutes. I could not find the second after about 15 minutes of combing this godforsaken second blizzard. I gave up. The momentum of this game comes to a screeching halt in this act. The new enemies in the zone were not enough to outshine the glaring issues I encountered here. I understand this is a solo dev game. It shows great promise, truly! I am excited to see future developments, and will revise my review should changes be made. But as it stands now, I cannot recommend this game. It needs time to cook.

It's honestly criminal this game isn't receiving more attention. A solo dev has managed to make a fun combat-centric game with a huge variety of playstyles that, as you progress, you can blend together for awesome combos. I would wish for a number of things for this game, but all of it can come far later. Letting the dev cook at the moment is the best thing to do, given how each update adds great new content.

Fun, extremely satisfying combat and a ton of build diversity - a perfect recipe for a melee RPG. It has a great foundational melee combat with your typical dodge/block/parry, but the augment system that allows you to customize and combine different equipment and weapon mechanics amplifies the combat feel even more. You will feel like a god cleaving through hordes of enemies which will still kill you if you make mistakes in your skill or your build. It kind of fits the category of 'first-person Path of Exile' for me - creating builds will be most of your playtime and the rest of the game is just experimenting with mechanics that synergize, and scaling it up as much as you want. There's so many different interactions, and though some are clearly outdated and weaker than newer items/weapons, you will always find some sort of niche that yo u prefer the most. Some slight negatives: The game is a bit lacking in boss content but understandable in Early Access. Bosses are also a bit annoying to fight as they move around a lot, and they don't really force you to interact with their movesets. It's not a Souls-like dance but more of a statcheck for your build. The world design is a bit obtuse, especially in later areas where the area is just too big with too many dead ends that made exploration a little infuriating. However the combat is just so good you won't really get bored when there's a swarm of enemies every few steps.

作者没玩过DOOM我是不信的。踏马的，进游戏我直接砍砍砍！什么主人?给装备、出生自带超模能力，这明明是义父。我直接为了义父360度无敌旋转砍砍砍。说回正题：非常推荐喜欢刷刷刷以及肉鸽砍杀的玩家购入 评分：8/10 美术：9/10，整体美术风格很好，该阳光明媚的平原做的很美，该昏暗的洞穴做的也很好，整体上每个地图板块都比较有特色 音乐：7/10，说实话，光顾着砍人没仔细听，没有太多印象，但是没有槽点还是中规中矩的 玩法：9/10，从人物性能上来说几乎无能力锁（武器的技能需要人物等级提升），无坠落伤害。从高处坠落自带雷霆攻击（是的，从高处坠落直接落地一个雷霆跺脚砸小怪头上），主角自带空中冲刺、跳跃和位移以及无敌闪避，而且闪避几乎能做到无CD衔接，非常超模的角色性能（简直就是不会摔死在板边的doom），然后玩法就是主角听从主人的命令去追杀任务目标，也就是一路上砍砍砍。然后回家升级喜欢的武器以及喜欢的build继续砍砍砍 丰富度：6/10，有着数十种多个类型的武器供你选择，不用担心找不到不喜欢的，而且武器获取非常快速，武器会通过刷小怪爆出来且爆率极高，通常推一会就能有一背包武器。当然其他的饰品也同理.但是因为本游戏目前是测试版本，且更新是真的慢，我一度认为作者跑路了，导致试剂可以游玩的只有一张地图。。 缺点：整体上build很吃局外养成而且需要刷很多材料才能升级。还有就是没有地图导致会迷路，作者放了很多支路让你去探索，但支路上的奖励给的很抠搜，导致游玩时间短时间减少。地图太大，真的很迷惑。 我只能说：马勒戈壁的作者，赶紧给我更新，然后加一点局内养成吧。

VOIN has very strong bones. The feeling of core combat is great. The itemisation is varied and interesting. The audio-visual side of things is on-point. But I can't bring myself to play anymore after just a few hours. The problems are the level design, enemy design and combat balance. The maps are open and empty, with very little in terms of interesting level design or engaging traversal puzzles. They feel a bit unfinished. Secondly, enemies are very one-note (litery, most of them have only one attack) so fighting them becomes very repetetive. And considering that most of them have no intresting skills, fighting becomes and endless cycle of mindlessly dodging and attacking. Also, the evenmy variety is absolutelly abysmall. Now that I look back on the trailers, they truthfully show you fighting hordes of identical started enemy in 90% of the shots. Wish I saw it as a red flag before I passed the refund window. Third strike against Voin is how quickly its combat devolves into mindlessly grinding hundreds of identical enemy groups into a fine paste. Just like the endgame of most ARPGS, but with no elements that make it actually bearable (like skill progression, story, quests, varied loot drops, puzzles etc etc). Maybe the problem is me. I came in expecting something souls-like adjecent, or at least more like Darktide, and got Diablo. It might be fun for people who enjoy hack-and-slashers (although a very limited item pool that's very front-loaded and leaves very few suprises after the first two hours will probably be a big turn-off), but it isn't for me. I wonder just how many positive reviews are from people with just a couple of hours under their belt, because I started out really liking the game, and fell out of love the longer I played it.
